# Oman exterior artwork
Local-only street reconstruction pending Koda approval. Generated concept is in Docs/References/OmanStreetConcept.png. IvoryPlasterOriginal and ShopSignsOriginal are preserved; derived tile and sign crops are consumed by OmanStreetPreview. Additional five signs use correctly shaped Arabic raster typography. No cars/people baked into assets. No third-party reference photograph included.

SafetyGlassFineOriginal.png is generated source artwork used as a low-opacity, lit fine-crumb contact layer below real closed fragments; transparent background haze is rejected. Full five-call prompt set is in GENERATION_PROMPTS.md. No emission or screen-grab refraction.

Road and pavement originals, full prompts and packing provenance are in ROAD_GENERATION_PROMPTS.md and sources.json. RoadSurfaceRepair packs three asphalt crack masks and a separate concrete fracture mask into RGBA, authors parking layout from scene dimensions, and imports derived aggregate normals. All material data are mipmapped; linear crack masks preserve alpha as data.
